verdict.rationale: Ramp documents interest only on US-dollar balances: a Checking Account at 2% APY and an Investment Account at up to 4.46%. Its Banking guide states "Banking is US-only," and nothing in the pack shows balances held, let alone earning interest, in other currencies. USD-only yield is an adjacent capability, not multi-currency yield, and the stablecoin support covers Bill Pay payments, not interest-bearing balances.
